description: A user-defined filterbank whose band FREQUENCIES AND AMPLITUDES MOVE OVER TIME - the time-varying sibling of userbank. Pinned to submode 1 (pitches in Hz; submode 2 = MIDI, same argv). The fdata parameter is an auxiliary text file (write_data_file()): each line is 'time pitch1 amp1 [pitch2 amp2 ...]' - every line must carry the SAME number of pairs (refusal verbatim: 'Too many entries in row 2 of file ...'); times ascending ('Time is out of sequence on line 3'); the first time need NOT be zero (a 0.5-start file rendered, exit 0 - contrast varibank2 which demands 0); kill a band mid-file by setting its amp to 0; amps may be dB; ';' comments legal. The bank interpolates between the timed states. Output = indur + tail exactly, with the family's undocumented tail default 1.0 s (pinned explicitly). Q is time-variable (brk verified against both endpoints); gain refuses brks. UNDOCUMENTED SWITCHES (source cdp2k/parstruct.c set_vflgs 'don'): besides the bannered -d (double filtering), the binary accepts -o (drop-out-at-overflow, DROP_OUT_AT_OVFLOW - byte-identical no-op on a non-overflowing render) and -n (auto-NORMALIZE: runs the 'Assessing input/output level' pre-pass and rescales gain - RMS 0.0042 -> 0.178 on the probe). The -n pre-pass is the do_norm path (filters0.c:85 vflag[2]) but the varybank internal-param slots exist, so the P5-1 vintage OOB-write does not apply. Deterministic; mono and stereo accepted.
musical_use: Draw a spectral trajectory as text and pour any sound through it: gliding chords, formant morphs (vowel A to vowel O as two timed band-sets), converging/diverging cluster glissandi, slow spectral tides. Each line of the fdata file is a snapshot of the whole bank; CDP glides every band between snapshots, so two lines make one big morph and many lines make an evolving score. Amp columns voice each band independently - fade bands in/out over time by automating their amps toward 0. Use -h to give every pitch a stack of harmonics (instant rich 'vocal' resonance; watch speed, pitches x harmonics costs time) with -r tilting the stack darker. High Q + noise input = pure moving chords; low Q keeps the source audible inside the moving colour. Layer a Q breakpoint on top for focus that tightens as the bands move. The -n switch normalizes the result when high Q eats all the level.

fdata.description: REQUIRED text file (write_data_file()): lines of 'time pitch1 amp1 [pitch2 amp2 ...]', same pair-count per line, times ascending (need not start at 0), pitches in Hz (this submode), amps numeric or dB (0 silences a band). Refusals verbatim in the entry description. Resolved against the session's data/ directory.

q.description: Filter tightness (family range 0.001-10000). Time-variable and VERIFIED: a 20->500 breakpoint rendered and differs from both scalar-endpoint renders.

gain.description: Overall gain (family range 0.001-10000). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 2 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.').

tail.description: Ring-out appended after the input; output = indur + tail sample-exact (verified 1 s and 2 s inputs, -t2). Undocumented CDP default 1.0 s - pinned explicitly. Family tail-0 bug assumed live; curated minimum 0.01.

hcnt.description: Number of harmonics of each pitch to include (default 1 = fundamentals only; -h3 verified, changes render). High harmonics of high pitches may exceed Nyquist; pitches x harmonics sets processing cost.

rolloff.description: Level drop from one harmonic to the next, CDP-enforced -96 to 0 dB ('Parameter[6] Value (5.000000) out of range (-96.000000 to 0.000000)'). Only meaningful with hcnt > 1.

overflow_dropout.description: UNDOCUMENTED (absent from the usage banner; source vflag DROP_OUT_AT_OVFLOW): abandon the run if the output overflows. Accepted, byte-identical no-op on a non-overflowing render.

normalize.description: UNDOCUMENTED (absent from the banner; source filters0.c do_norm via vflag[2]): pre-scans input and output levels ('INFO: Assessing input level.' / 'Assessing output level.') and rescales gain to match input level - verified live (RMS 0.0042 -> 0.178). Adds a full extra pass; render time roughly triples.

examples.description: Two-band spectral glide: 300+1200 Hz opening out to 600+900 Hz over 1.5 s.
examples.expected_use: First write_data_file('vb_glide.txt', '0.0  300 1.0  1200 0.5\n1.5  600 1.0  900 0.8'). Bands glide between the two states; -n restores level; output = indur + 1 (pinned tail default).

examples.description: Vowel-ish morph with harmonic stacks: 3 harmonics per pitch, dark tilt, tightening Q.
examples.expected_use: Each moving band carries 3 harmonics at -6 dB/step while the Q breakpoint tightens the focus across the file.

known_issues: UNDOCUMENTED SWITCHES -o and -n (first-class): the banner lists only -d, but parstruct.c declares switches 'don' and both are accepted. -n runs the normalization pre-pass (do_norm, filters0.c:85) and rescales gain; -o enables drop-out-at-overflow. On pre-11cdcb4 vintage binaries the -n pre-pass epilogue wrote FLT_FRQ_INDEX/FLT_TIMES_CNT unguarded, but varybank internal-param slots include indices 20/21, so the write was in-bounds - no P5-1 hang here; version_sensitive stays false.

fdata format enforced per line: equal pair counts ('Too many entries in row 2 of file ...'), ascending times ('Time is out of sequence on line 3' - line numbers count comment lines too). Times may start after 0 (0.5-start verified, exit 0) - contrast varibank2's zero-start rule.
Undocumented tail default 1.0 s (re-verified: 2 s -> 3.0000 sample-exact with no -t); entry pins it. tail 0 not probed here - family bug assumed, curated min 0.01.
Only Q accepts breakpoint files (verified against both endpoints); gain refuses as parameter 2.
Deterministic (two runs 1.2 s apart byte-identical); stereo accepted.
Submode 2 (MIDI pitch columns) same argv - separate triple, not curated. 'filter vfilters' generates fixed-pitch fdata files from pitch data if needed (execute()).
